name: Venerable Stubblade
description: Open in the paired court stance with the short sword forward and the off hand covering the body.

name: Revelation Pointcap
description: Test the gap with a light tap of the blade and read from the answer how the opponent stands.

name: Stabgrace
description: Enter on a matched pair of paces that bring the point inside the opponent's reach together with the off hand.

name: Inviolate Cutedge
description: Parry in the mirror of the opponent's own cut and let both blades slide past the body.

name: Subjugating Hiltcap
description: Beat the opponent's blade and pin it between the short sword and the off-hand guard with qi.

name: Pulsar Gore
description: Prick with the short sword at the moment the off hand takes the opponent's attention.

name: Sacrosanct Knobgrip
description: Rotate the sword and off-hand guard in turn so that the body is always covered on both sides.

name: Gallant Dig
description: Cross the short sword and off-hand weapon through the guard in a scissoring cut backed by qi.

name: Peremptory Nick
description: Break the opponent's guard with a paired beat that leaves him open for the finishing stab.

name: Digpledge
description: Break the opponent's whole stance with two beats from two sides that crush his guard and balance.

name: Triumphant Prism Stabtip
description: Finish with the school's prized stab in which sword and off hand strike together and the point goes deep.

name: Consecrated Shortspine
description: Stand utterly still with the point low in the manner of water resting in a basin.

name: Eclipse Handguard
description: Fix the gaze on one spot of the opponent's body and wait for it to move.

name: Digvoyage
description: Step out of the stillness in a widening ripple that ends close to the opponent's flank.

name: Thumbvow
description: Turn aside a cut with a motion so small that the stance appears not to move.

name: Dauntless Sting
description: Drop from stillness into a sudden prick at the opponent's wrist or throat.

name: Thrall Broadleaf
description: Draw the opponent's blade into the guard with a slow turn that leaves him overextended.

name: Intrepid Poke
description: Cut from stillness in a falling arc that gathers all the stored weight into one slash.

name: Immaculate Hiltcap
description: Hold a deep still guard in which each cut dies against the unmoving blade.

name: Vacuumgore
description: Rise from long stillness and drive one qi-heavy stab through the guard faster than the eye can follow.

name: Paramount Stabtip
description: Wait in the basin stance and fall on the opponent in a single stab the instant his guard shifts.

name: Undefiled Pointcap
description: Stand loose with the blade low like a boulder in a stream that lets the water pass.

name: Valiant Gore
description: Thrust with a flowing motion that begins in the hip and runs unbroken down the arm.

name: Tipboon
description: Step along the line of the opponent's movement and keep the point trained upon him.

name: Faithful Cutedge
description: Sweep a cut aside in a long curve that carries its force away from the body.

name: Stingedict
description: Dart in with a quick prick like a fish and slip away before the guard closes.

name: Authoritative Stabtip
description: Hook beneath the opponent's blade and drag it down and away with a sudden turn.

name: Squall Knobgrip
description: Spin into a turning guard that sends several cuts around the body without a clash.

name: Orchestral Dig
description: Rush in a series of stabs that swell and quicken like a river in spring.

name: Digverdict
description: Curve the slash round the opponent's guard like a river round a bluff and cut the open side.

name: Devout Thumbrest
description: Hold a guard that gathers the opponent's blows like a weir and lets them go in measured flow.

name: Despotic Nick
description: Draw the opponent along a great sweeping current of force so that he cannot choose his own footing.

name: Majestic Gore Crown
description: Turn the opponent's own force in the river's bend and send it back through a single deep stab.

name: Stately Stubblade
description: Stand with body and qi on separate paths and the blade at the point where they will join.

name: Peal Hiltcap
description: Probe the opponent's body line with a light touch of the blade and read his balance.

name: Windborne Stab
description: Take a pace on the second track so that the opponent's line of attack falls on the empty one.

name: Sainted Broadleaf
description: Parry on the offset track so the opponent's cut meets nothing and his body is turned.

name: Prism Dig
description: Split the stab along both tracks so the point arrives from where the opponent does not look.

name: Tyrannous Poke
description: Break the opponent's rhythm with a beat on the track he is not watching.

name: Harmonious Nick
description: Weave stab and step and beat across both tracks in a pattern that never repeats.

name: Pokebanner
description: Slash along both tracks together so qi and steel arrive in one hard cut.

name: Stubseal
description: Recover to a guard along both tracks and leave no opening for a counter.

name: Steelsting
description: Unite the two tracks at the point and break through a guard that held against either alone.

name: Unrivaled Stabtip
description: Bring body and qi together in a single blade of force at the point and drive it through the guard.

name: Sphere Shortspine
description: Hold the field wide and high as if from a perch and read the whole ground below.

name: Enshrined Broadleaf
description: Hold a coiled crouch with qi pooled in the legs and the blade drawn back.

name: Skyborne Knobgrip
description: Rise onto the ball of the foot on a pulse of qi and hang for one breath before the drop.

name: Squall Hiltcap
description: Turn a cut aside in a wide sweeping stroke like a wing spreading against the wind.

name: Penumbra Poke
description: Glide along the edge of the opponent's reach as along a basin rim and choose the moment to fall.

name: Nickseal
description: Pin the opponent's blade under the guard like a talon holding prey while the point comes up.

name: Fearless Dig
description: Stab at the single weak spot spied from above before the opponent moves to cover it.

name: Inviolate Shortspine
description: Hold the body on a cushion of qi so that cuts from every side lose their force.

name: Gorebanner
description: Plunge from a leap with the point leading and drive it through the guard with the whole fall.

name: Stinggrace
description: Rise back off the strike on an updraft of qi and settle beyond the opponent's reach.

name: Interstice Gore
description: Flash across the whole gap from a height and land a stab before the field can warn the opponent.

name: Illustrious Pulsar Sting
description: Hover unseen above the opponent's field and fall in one terrible stab at the weakest point.

name: Revered Thumbrest
description: Stand with the weight low and the Core steady behind the navel while the blade holds the line.

name: Kernel Cutedge
description: Feel two rivers of qi rise from the Core and settle along each arm.

name: Pokevoyage
description: Step aside along the course of the nearer river and set the point on the opponent's flank.

name: Nucleus Stubblade
description: Draw qi from the Core into the blade to turn aside a heavy cut with ease.

name: Noble Stab
description: Send both streams down the blade and prick through a thin gap in the guard.

name: Stabtroth
description: Cross the two streams over the opponent's blade and hold it as if in the arms of a river.

name: Splendid Poke
description: Pulse the Core through both arms into a single deep cut with the short edge.

name: Titan Knobgrip
description: Hold a steady guard fed straight from the Core against a long assault.

name: Nickedict
description: Raise both rivers at once from the Core and burst through the guard in a single stab.

name: Imperial Nick
description: Meet the two rivers of the Core at the point of the short sword and release them in one deep stab.

name: Faithful Stubblade
description: Open with the school's greeting stance blade low and facing the wind as the oath requires.

name: Peal Cutedge
description: Read the wind on the skin and the opponent's breath in it to judge his coming move.

name: Digsolace
description: Close the distance in sworn paces that are neither hurried nor halted.

name: Squall Pointcap
description: Turn a cut aside with the edge as a gust turns a loose leaf from its path.

name: Unwavering Hiltcap
description: Hold the guard on a fixed bearing in the wind with qi steady in the arm.

name: Steel Poke
description: Prick on the rise of a gust where the sound of the wind covers the motion.

name: Unbending Dig
description: Bind the opponent's blade with a pressure that does not release until the oath is met.

name: Symphonic Stab
description: Chain strikes that quicken with each beat like a wind rising toward a gale.

name: Stingdecree
description: Slash with qi carried on the wind in an oath-held arc that does not waver.

name: Undaunted Handguard
description: Hold a guard unmoving as the plateau against a gale of blows.

name: Squallnick
description: Pierce the guard in a stab sworn to the line with the wind's weight added to qi.

name: Dauntless Vacuum Poke
description: Swear the stab to the close wind and drive the point to its mark with the school's full weight.

name: Devout Shortspine
description: Stand with the blade pointing along the chosen bearing across open plateau ground.

name: Serene Handguard
description: Check the bearing against a far mark and correct the stance without moving the point.

name: Goreboon
description: Advance along the bearing in paced steps that never cross the line.

name: Stately Knobgrip
description: Parry across the wind with a motion that rides the breeze to turn the blade aside.

name: Millstone Hiltcap
description: Hold the line of the bearing and bar the opponent from crossing it.

name: Pokeverdict
description: Stab along the bearing with the point never leaving the line until it lands.

name: Feather Stabtip
description: Step along the edge of the plateau's footing and set the stab at the opponent's side.

name: Lordly Dig
description: Drive the whole body along the bearing in a single qi-heavy impaling stab.

name: Consecrated Pointcap
description: Hold an open guard on the plateau and let the bearing turn each cut aside.

name: Statute Broadleaf
description: Hold the bearing to the very end of the field and press the opponent flat against it.

name: Majestic Nick
description: Take the bearing at the plateau edge and carry the point to the mark in one unbroken stab.

name: Sainted Thumbrest
description: Take the oath stance with the blade level and the voice silent before the first exchange.

name: Tipcrown
description: Thrust once at the named target and recover to the oath line.

name: Nickvoyage
description: Advance a pace at a time while keeping the point fixed on the named mark.

name: Unwavering Cutedge
description: Parry with an edge that holds its line so that the blow glances off without effect.

name: Sigil Knobgrip
description: Press and bind the blade as a binding word holds the speaker to the oath.

name: Venerable Hiltcap
description: Return at once to the pledge guard after each strike with no gap left behind.

name: Heroic Sting
description: Cut with qi bound to the oath so that the edge does not turn from the line.

name: Sacrosanct Stubblade
description: Hold the guard through the whole exchange as a vow held through hardship.

name: Revelation Stab
description: Make good a sworn word in one stab that the opponent cannot parry or turn.

name: Gallant Volition Poke
description: Deliver the oath school's thrust held as a vow that carries the full weight of the sworn purpose.

name: Immaculate Broadleaf
description: Stand with the blade tucked close to the body and the wind at the shoulder.

name: Luminous Stubblade
description: Read the stir of air between the bodies to know how near the opponent has come.

name: Stabsolace
description: Take a quick short step on a gust to close the last handspan of the gap.

name: Squall Shortspine
description: Parry along the edge of the opponent's blade and hug it down to the guard.

name: Valiant Stab
description: Snap a prick out on a gust of wind that adds speed to the point.

name: Digseal
description: Bind the opponent's blade with a pressure like a gale leaning on a door.

name: Ethereal Nick
description: Slide inside the opponent's reach on a stream of air that hides the step.

name: Choral Poke
description: Rush with three short stabs that grow faster as the wind builds under them.

name: Storied Dig
description: Rip the edge across the opponent's guard arm with the wind behind the cut.

name: Tipvow
description: Hold a ward of close-moving air about the body that blunts cuts at the blade's reach.

name: Prism Sting
description: Pierce so softly and swiftly that the wind seems to carry the point through the guard.

name: Matchless Dig
description: Close on the opponent in one rush of wind and finish with the short edge before he can answer.

name: Sphere Knobgrip
description: Spread the field wide over open ground and read every shift of weight within it.

name: Enshrined Cutedge
description: Set a low stance on bare ground with the blade forward and no cover behind.

name: Mighty Nick
description: Stride with the wind at the back and bring the point onto the opponent at the last pace.

name: Penumbra Handguard
description: Shear a cut aside with a slicing stroke that runs the length of the opponent's blade.

name: Nickpledge
description: Press the blade down against the ground and hold it while the point rises.

name: Exalted Gore
description: Stab in the open under the wide sky with a thrust that has no wall to stop it.

name: Spectral Dig
description: Rush inside a swirl of dust and wind that hides the line of approach.

name: Digdecree
description: Impale the opponent with the cliff wind's weight behind a deep qi-driven stab.

name: Revered Shortspine
description: Hold an unmoving guard that gives away nothing in the open and takes the whole wind.

name: Pulsarnick
description: Flash across the open ground on the wind and strike with the short edge before the field warns.

name: Intrepid Dig Banner
description: Cross the open ground at the wind's pace and drive one short stab through the guard.

name: Sacrosanct Handguard
description: Stand with the Core turning slowly like a storm eye and the blade level before it.

name: Kernel Knobgrip
description: Read the pressure of the opponent's field as a sailor reads the edge of a storm.

name: Nucleus Poke
description: Step on a gust drawn from the Core and close the opponent's reach in a single pace.

name: Squall Stubblade
description: Turn a cut aside in a short whirl of Core wind that robs it of its force.

name: Kernel Sting
description: Prick with qi drawn straight from the Core and held to the oath.

name: Masterful Hiltcap
description: Hold the centre line in a calm of the Core and press the opponent's blade slowly aside.

name: Triumphant Nick
description: Cut with the storm of the Core running along the edge in a single wind-heavy slash.

name: Thumbpledge
description: Hold a ward of Core wind about the body that no ordinary cut will cross.

name: Spatesting
description: Burst the Core's gale through the point in a single stab that tears through guard and armor.

name: Lordly Stab
description: Swear the Core's storm to the short edge and release it in one deep stab to the mark.
